C0620.title: Coupon scalpers cash out government vouchers for over 180,000 yuan, court rules it constitutes fraud
C0620.summary: Xu from Jiangsu organized individuals to use third-party software to remotely claim large quantities of Xuchang government e-vouchers, then colluded with two local restaurant operators Ge and Gao to cash them out through fake transactions, defrauding over 180,000 yuan. In December 2022, the court sentenced six defendants to prison terms ranging from two to three years for fraud.
